title: Same-TL Finite Armor Regeneration Reserve Diagnostic
energyDoctrine: SafeOverloadFirst until Energy Strain Limit 2, then Standard; Low only when power-constrained.
diagnosticPurpose: Repeat CP136 with common random numbers after changing only regenerative Armor tactical endurance: finite in-combat reserves of 3/4/5/6 AI at TL6-TL9. All numerical values, Shield/DamCon/weapon/PDS/reference-build rules, and study geometry are held. Measure reserve exhaustion, persistent Armor progress, Hull/DamCon activity, TL6 mainline-vs-Crystalline behavior, and family viability.
damageControlDoctrine: HullOnlyWhenDamaged; one attempt/turn; 1 TP + 1 kit per attempt; success queues to next Turn Refresh; component repair off; Armor regeneration uses remaining TP.
comparisonBaseline: Native-accepted CP136 substantive 1,960,000-engagement diagnostic; same context/variant identities and master seed retained.
